facts.fact: Tilde 站在她面前，手朝她伸着，羽毛从指间冒出，顺手腕手臂爬到脖颈
facts.anchor: Tilde had stood, her hand outstretched, feathers sprouting from her fingers

facts.fact: 王后 Marolyn 死在她脚边，双眼空着，像被敲裂的头骨
facts.anchor: And Marolyn, blank-eyed and dead as a cracked skull beneath her feet.

facts.fact: 她的兄弟们尖叫着扭曲变形为怪物，随后逃离蓝厅
facts.anchor: Her brothers had twisted, screaming, transformed into monstrosities, and fled.

facts.fact: 八岁的 Hein 身上长出羽毛，撑破衣服，卷曲如夏日蕨叶
facts.anchor: Feathers taking root in him, bursting through his clothes, curling up like summer ferns

facts.fact: 她把 Tilde 当爱人放进自己的床，如今称她为异教徒与女巫
facts.anchor: They had let a heathen inside their court, and Elise had let a witch inside her bed

facts.fact: Elise 回房收拾，女仆 Torna 正在补一件破裙子，立刻动手替她装包
facts.anchor: Elise went back to her room, threw open the door and Torna leapt up from darning a frayed dress

facts.fact: 两名绿罩袍骑士来传父王召见，说王子们「跑了」
她终究不肯告发 Tilde，怕自己或两人一起被祭司烧死
facts.anchor: But even now she could not bring herself to betray her lover.
